rows.comparison_as_reported: homozygous G/G genotype vs not stated (presumably other genotypes)
rows.subgroup: Adult AML patients during induction chemotherapy (n=164); outcome pulmonary IFD
rows.verbatim_source: patients carrying the homozygous Dectin-1 SNP rs7309123 (G/G genotype, n=43 patients) revealed a significantly higher risk for developing ... pulmonary IFD (p=0.023, OR: 2.3; 95% CI: 1.2 - 4.5). In detail, 24 patients harbouring homozygous Dectin-1 SNP developed pneumonia in general whereas 18 of them fulfilled criteria for IFD.
rows.note: Model word not given by paper; GG vs reference group not specified (likely recessive GG vs GT+TT). Other allele not reported. 18 GG patients met IFD criteria (43 GG patients total); counts for other genotypes not reported. Methods state multiple logistic regression but unclear whether this OR is multivariable-adjusted. Outcome is pulmonary IFD (EORTC/MSG), not specifically IA.

rows.comparison_as_reported: heterozygous T/G (n=13) vs wild type carriers
rows.subgroup: Adult AML patients during induction chemotherapy (n=164); all analyzed infectious complications incl. IFD
rows.verbatim_source: no differences were found between patients with heterozygous Dectin-1 SNP rs16910526 (Y238X, T/G genotype, n=13 patients) and wild type carriers with regard to all analyzed infectious complications.
rows.note: Only qualitative null result; no estimate, p-value or case/control genotype counts. Paper does not state which allele (T or G) is the variant/stop allele, so alleles left null. 13 heterozygous patients total.

paper_note: Conference abstract (EHA 2015, P745) of 164 AML patients; rs7309123 GG associated with pulmonary IFD (OR 2.3), rs16910526 Y238X heterozygotes showed no difference; no genotype tables reported.
